observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: an outdoor park or grassy area with trees, during a daytime community gathering or festival
observation.dancers: a mixed group of adult men and women, numbering around ten to fifteen people
observation.formation_and_space: a single large circle formation where dancers hold hands and step sideways together
observation.posture: upright posture with relaxed torso, knees slightly soft, weight shifting side-to-side
observation.footwork: simple side-to-side stepping pattern where dancers step to the side and bring the other foot to close on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: hands held in a continuous circle with neighbors, arms held loosely at waist level
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso movement, upper body relatively still while stepping
observation.partnering: hand-to-hand contact with adjacent dancers forming a circle, no lead-and-follow partnering
observation.levels_jumps_turns: none; feet stay on the ground with a continuous low-level stepping motion
observation.costume_and_props: traditional attire including sarees and dhotis, patterned vests, sashes, orange bead necklaces, and caps; some participants hold microphones or wear headpieces
observation.cannot_infer: fast footwork details and exact weight shifts are obscured by low resolution and camera motion

signature_moments.what: dancers holding hands in a circle stepping side-to-side in unison
